name: archie-heat-load-calculator
description: Archie Heat Load Calculator — evidence-first PDF intake, AI research handoff, and cooling/heating load calculation.

scripts.test:python: cd .. && for test in tests/test_*.py; do PYTHONPATH=. python3 "$test" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: cd .. && export ARCHIE_DESIGN_WEATHER_TABLE=/nonexistent ARCHIE_U_VALUE_TABLE=/nonexistent OPENROUTER_API_KEY= OPENAI_API_KEY= ANTHROPIC_API_KEY= DEEPSEEK_API_KEY= && for test in tests/test_*.py; do PYTHONPATH=. python3 "$test" || exit 1; done && cd frontend && playwright test

_note: The frontend has no build step or runtime npm dependency — index.html, css/ and js/
are served as-is. Playwright is a development dependency for browser tests. This file exists so tooling that expects a package.json can find
one, and so `npm run dev` starts the app.
The app is NOT a static site. It needs the Python backend for /api/upload,
frontend folder to a static host will render the interface but every action fails.
Requires poppler on the host for page previews and page counts: brew install poppler.
